import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
from collections import Counter
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("input/ru_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")

# Create validation split by sentence_id (sentence-level split to avoid leakage)
train_sentences = train["sentence_id"].unique()
train_split, val_sentences = train_test_split(
    train_sentences, test_size=0.15, random_state=42
)
train_val = train[train["sentence_id"].isin(train_split)].reset_index(drop=True)
val = train[train["sentence_id"].isin(val_sentences)].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Train/val split: {len(train_val)} / {len(val)}")


def extract_features(text):
    """Extract text features from a token"""
    text = str(text).strip().lower() if pd.notna(text) else ""
    features = {}

    # Character features
    features["char_length"] = len(text)
    features["digit_count"] = len(re.findall(r"\d", text))
    features["space_count"] = text.count(" ")
    features["punct_count"] = len(re.findall(r"[.,;:!?:—-]", text))
    features["letter_count"] = len(re.findall(r"[a-zа-яё]", text))
    features["upper_count"] = len(re.findall(r"[A-ZА-ЯЁ]", text))

    # N-gram features
    ngrams = re.findall(r".{1,4}", text)
    features["ngram_count"] = len(ngrams)

    # Common patterns for Russian normalization
    features["number_pattern"] = len(re.findall(r"\d+\s+\.?\s*\d+\.?", text))
    features["date_pattern"] = len(
        re.findall(
            r"(январ|февраль|март|апрель|май|июнь|июль|август|сентябрь|октябрь|ноябрь|декабрь)",
            text,
            re.I,
        )
    )
    features["trans_count"] = text.count("_trans")

    # Cyrillic check
    features["cyrillic"] = 1 if re.search(r"[а-яё]", text) else 0

    return features


print("\nExtracting features...")
train_features = train["before"].apply(extract_features)
val_features = val["before"].apply(extract_features)
test_features = test["before"].apply(extract_features)

# Flatten features
train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_features.tolist(), index=train.index)
val_df = pd.DataFrame(val_features.tolist(), index=val.index)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_features.tolist(), index=test.index)

print(f"Feature columns: {train_df.columns.tolist()}")

# Use frequency-based prediction (most effective for this token-level task)
print("\nBuilding frequency map...")
train_by_before = train.groupby("before")["after"].agg(
    lambda x: x.mode().iloc[0] if len(x.mode()) > 0 else "UNKNOWN"
)
print(f"Unique 'before' values with mappings: {len(train_by_before)}")

# Get overall most frequent after for unknown cases
overall_most_common = (
    train["after"].mode().iloc[0] if len(train["after"].mode()) > 0 else "."
)
print(f"Overall most common 'after': {overall_most_common}")

# Create predictions for validation set (using validation-only training data)
print("\nGenerating validation predictions...")
val_predictions = []
for idx, row in val.iterrows():
    before_text = row["before"]
    if before_text in train_by_before.index:
        after_text = train_by_before[before_text]
    else:
        after_text = overall_most_common
    val_predictions.append(after_text)

# Assign predictions to the validation DataFrame with matching indices
val_df["after_pred"] = pd.Series(val_predictions, index=val.index)

# Calculate accuracy metric (token-level exact match)
print("\nCalculating validation accuracy...")
val_exact_matches = (val["after"] == val_df["after_pred"]).sum()
val_total = len(val)
val_accuracy = val_exact_matches / val_total
print(f"Validation Exact Match Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")
print(f"Exact matches: {val_exact_matches} / {val_total}")

# Generate test predictions
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
test_predictions = []
for idx, row in test.iterrows():
    before_text = row["before"]
    if before_text in train_by_before.index:
        after_text = train_by_before[before_text]
    else:
        after_text = overall_most_common
    test_predictions.append(after_text)

test["after"] = test_predictions

print("\nCreating submission file...")
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": [
            f"{sid}_{tid}" for sid, tid in zip(test["sentence_id"], test["token_id"])
        ],
        "after": test["after"],
    }
)

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")

# Verify submission format
print("\n=== Submission Verification ===")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission (first 3 rows):")
print(submission.head(3))

# Verify we have correct number of predictions
print(f"\nUnique 'after' values in submission: {submission['after'].nunique()}")
print(f"Submission ready for evaluation!")

# Final validation check
print(f"\n=== Final Results ===")
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")
print(f"Submission file location: submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission rows: {len(submission)}")
